behavioral_intents: Detect execution of critical Windows system processes (lsass, winlogon, svchost, etc.) from non-standard directories, a common technique for masquerading malware as legitimate system components.
Detect UAC bypass attempts that hijack the mscfile (Task Scheduler) shell handler registry path to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.
Detect scheduled task creation via PowerShell cmdlets or CIM methods, which attackers use for persistence and privilege escalation
Detects attempts to dump LSASS process memory using RdrLeakDiag or tool masquerading to extract credentials.
